image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rough, wet rocky surface. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates. These plates feature a striking pattern of reddish-brown and cream-colored wavy lines. The plates are surrounded by a thick, fleshy girdle that is pinkish-red with small white speckles. The background consists of out-of-focus grey rock texture.
